material_advances: Recovered and reconciled the max-length Universal Control chat against later durable Git history instead of treating the chat's final observed state as Current.
Confirmed that Favorites and Corner Anchor were already materially integrated before this migration and preserved both as Golden Master behavior.
Implemented a Favorites compatibility facade over the exact existing localStorage owner `prometeo.v5.favorites.v1`.
Matched the served normalization semantics exactly: invalid/empty ids are ignored and duplicate page ids are deduplicated in first-occurrence order.
Preserved legacy no-crash semantics when localStorage is unavailable.
Materialized the exact served V5 plaintext source from the five chunks and verified SHA-256 before every candidate build.
Built a self-contained candidate by replacing only the Favorites persistence block; no new runtime module/network dependency was introduced.
Structural roundtrip proved that undoing the allowed Favorites replacement recovers the byte-identical Golden Master outside that block.
Added and passed Node contract tests plus Chromium parity comparing Golden Master vs facade candidate online, local-only/offline, pin/unpin and Corner Anchor drag/persistence behavior.
Merged PR #13 to main as infrastructure only after both push and pull_request browser gates were green.

negative_knowledge_preserved: Do not combine backend extraction with visual redesign or Corner Anchor physics changes.

Do not use arbitrary fake favorite ids as an absolute browser expectation while the real online catalog legitimately prunes unknown ids; parity must compare against the Golden Master and use real catalog ids for persistence actions.
Do not switch Favorites to PrometeoDB merely because PrometeoDB exists; P2 is shadow parity with no canonical-write authority.
Do not hide degraded backend state by silently promoting fallback behavior into authority.
Do not republish Served V5 as part of an infrastructure-only backend extraction.
Do not use dead-chat chronology to undo later durable Corner Anchor integration.
next_safe_frontier: P2 SHADOW_PARITY: add a Favorites PrometeoDB shadow adapter behind the compatibility boundary. Legacy localStorage remains the only canonical read/write owner. Shadow writes/reads must be additive, idempotent and non-blocking; compare ordered page_id projections and reload/offline behavior; record mismatches without changing UI behavior. Do not cut over ownership or publish new Served bytes until explicit parity and rollback gates pass.
human_boundary: None for entering P2 shadow parity. Human acceptance becomes relevant only before a product-facing ownership cutover/Served promotion.
